title: Warlocks #2 Aircel Comics 1988 Barry Blair Elflord Creator Warlock 5 Spinoff
conditionDescription: Covers clean and glossy with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Warlocks #2 (1988), Aircel Comics - from Barry Blair, creator of Elflord; the Warlock 5 spinoff series. Original $1.95 cover price ($2.50 in Canada).

Back cover: Battle Armor role-playing game ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
